name: The Robot Boyfriend
source:
A long-awaited offline date with your mysterious date turns out to be as eventful as you think the moment he calls out your name.

You turn around in anticipation and find… a robot?!

Dive head-first into a mixture of surprise, confusion, and curiosity in this love-filled aquarium tale.

[From [url=https://nina-games.itch.io/the-robot-boyfriend]itch.io[/url]]
